why: Issue #356's cue must explain the active-shell cap and nothing else. Dropping the phase gate lets a tank that is already at its cap reach spawnBullet during the pre-round countdown, so the game announces a full magazine at a moment when firing was never on offer. The capacity check itself is untouched by this mutation -- only the order in which the two are consulted.
killedBy: what a refused shot says, per refusal path (issue #356) COUNTDOWN: silent, even with every shell already in the air
